questions.text: What made onboarding speed a board-level issue now, rather than a year ago?
questions.why: The real trigger, and how much pressure the sponsor is under

questions.text: If this engagement goes perfectly, what is different for customers in six weeks?
questions.why: The outcome the client pictures, in their own words

questions.text: What would make you call this engagement a failure, even if the tool works?
Can you walk me through the last application you worked on, from opening it to the decision?
questions.why: The real process, not the documented one

questions.text: Which document types take the longest, and roughly how many minutes each?
What happens to a case when the applicant has to send something again?
questions.why: Rework loops that grow the backlog

questions.text: How does the volume change across the year, and when is your next peak?
questions.why: Deadlines the client has not stated

questions.text: What records do you keep of past reviews, decisions and their reasons?
questions.why: Whether there is labelled history to build and test with

questions.text: Which systems hold the documents and cases, and can anything read from or write to them?
questions.why: Integration limits that shape the design

questions.text: Has the bank tried to automate any of this before, and what happened?
questions.why: Lessons, and the trust we start with

questions.text: Which decisions must always be made by a person, and who says so?
Who has to approve a change to KYC controls, and how long does that take?
questions.why: Approvals that sit on the critical path

questions.text: Where may customer documents be stored and processed, and which tools are blocked?
Which numbers will Martin look at to decide whether this worked?
How will you know your analysts actually want to use the tool?
questions.why: Adoption measures, from the users' side
